profile.headline: Software Developer at UnitedHealth Group
profile.summary: Innovative software developer with 13 years of experience developing, maintaining, and deploying multi-tiered business applications. Streamlined deployment of a set of applications utilizing Octopus Deploy. Worked to make applications more secure utilizing gMSA accounts and CyberArk vaults. A fast learner and team player interested in optimization and automation.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to build, maintain, and deploy multiple external facing websites, web services, and windows services utilizing C#, Visual Studio 2015 & 2017, Angular 4.0, PowerShell, and Octopus Deploy.

* Spearheaded the migration of current and legacy applications from PowerShell DSC deployment to a versioned Octopus Deploy deployment. Defined a process whereby the life-cycle from local development to prod was streamlined using a combination of configuration transformation and Octopus Deploy variable replacements. Made reusable PowerShell scripts to more easily interact with the Octopus Deploy API.

* Worked to migrate all existing application pools and windows services from using service accounts to using gMSA accounts. This was to ensure security and ease of management, because passwords would be unknowable and consistently changing on a predefined schedule, and each app pool and service would have its own dedicated account, ensuring less impact if a single account was compromised.

* Utilized a CyberArk strategy to store and retrieve passwords within an application on an allowed server, so that passwords could be removed from config files, making the applications more secure.

* Helped build an internal website that utilized Angular 4.0 with a web service API backend.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to build custom solutions for customers with websites built using a Sitefinity CMS and an Aptify CRM. Gained experience with responsive web development using .NET 4.0, Knockout, Angular and Bootstrap.

* Made a project that built and extracted data from forms using razor templates populated with Knockout and styled using Bootstrap, based on a generic form definition and data passed in via JSON. Utilized C#, .NET 4.0, Razor, Knockout, Bootstrap and JSON. 

* Made a module for importing excel data into a database, utilizing the Aptify CRM. Integrated the module into Aptify. Utilized C#, .NET 4.0 and Aptify.

* Worked on integrating upsell functionality into a website for PDA. Utiized ASP.NET 4.0, VB.NET, C#, Bootstrap, LESS, Aptify and Sitefinity.

* Worked on styling a site for SIOR.com that utilized the Higher Logic CMS. Utilized CSS, Bootstrap and jQuery.

* Worked on developing and styling a site for SIOR Foundation, that utilized services on the SIOR.com website. Used CSS, Bootstrap, ASMX Services, JSONP Ajax calls, Aptify and Sitefinity.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to gather requirements for, build, maintain, and optimize the company website and other miscellaneous apps/sites. The website was multi-tiered and included an application server that exposed web services and utilized custom windows services to streamline data processing. Gained experience in .NET 4.0, MVC3, Razor, jQuery, Web and Windows Services, SVN, StyleCop and Sharepoint.

* Built UFM, a windows application used for managing funds that lived outside of the internal Trading System. Gathered user requirements for multiple changes and implemented them, one of which included a report that tracked how money shifted from one category to another. Used C#, .NET 4.0, WCF Web Services, SQL Server.

* Refactored a screen used to search for metal in the Trading System, making it faster by making a dynamic SQL project. Utilized an MVP structure. Used C#, VB.NET 2.0, SQL Server and AJAX. 

* Worked on adding a page to the Trading System that mapped new cities against an existing 3rd party list of cities. Interfaced with Bing Maps to show the location of the city on a map as the user was adding it. Utilized ASP.NET 4.0, C#, MVC3, Razor, jQuery, JSON, and WCF Windows Services.

* Worked on extracting business logic from a web of nested stored procedures and functions and refactoring it into code within the Trading System, interfacing with simple stored procedures. Built unit tests for the code. Used C#, .NET 4.0, WCF Windows Services and NUnit.

* Added new screens to a standalone application used to import excel documents into the Trading System database. Utilized an MVVM structure. Used C#, XAML, .NET 4.0 and WCF Windows Services.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: VantageLinks landed me the job at Metal Exchange Corporation -- I contracted through them for six months.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to gather requirements for, build, maintain, optimize, and publish multiple n-tier web and windows applications and databases utilizing VB.NET 2.0, ASP.NET 2.0, AJAX, and SQL Server 2005 for multiple departments within the company.

* Worked on completely refactoring the website houseplansandmore.com and making updates to the data structure. Used ASP.NET 2.0, C#, AJAX and SQL Server 2005.

* Worked on developing and styling a web application for managing the process of buying books back from plan-o-grams. Used .NET 2.0, C# and SQL Server.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team to build and deploy full-cycle business applications using VB.NET, C#, ASP.NET and SQL Server.  Gained some experience as a project manager.  Worked on documenting applications in development using tools such as Microsoft Project, Visio, Excel, and Word.

* Worked on finishing an application for raynor.com for drawing and super-imposing door images on a garage, skewing the images 3-dimensionally. Used .NET 2.0, C# and SQL Server.

* Made a CMS website for raynor.com based on specifications, used to upload/edit the door images and data used to drive the windows front-end application. Used ASP.NET, C# and SQL Server.

* Worked on refactoring a website for CRS, a company that certifies scales for other companies, based on specifications. The website catalogued various customers and certifications. Used ASP.NET, C#, and SQL Server.

* Worked on managing and guiding a new developer as he worked through building out a scale certification web application for CRS.
